overall_goal: Clean dishes, tidy the workspace, and gather ingredients and utensils for cooking

goals.description: Prepare the sink area and wash the lid
goals.rationale: The person clears the tabletop, prepares the sink, and washes a lid with a sponge and dishwashing liquid.

goals.description: Wash the straining tray and saucepan
goals.rationale: The person cleans a straining tray and a saucepan in the sink and places them in the crockery tray.

goals.description: Wash plastic boxes and load a bowl into the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person washes plastic boxes in the sink and then places a bowl into the dishwasher.

goals.description: Wash the knife, spoon, and aluminum items
goals.rationale: The person washes a knife, a spoon, an aluminum lid, and an aluminum tin in the sink.

goals.description: Wash the frying pan, chopping board, and plate
goals.rationale: The person cleans a frying pan, a chopping board, and a plate, placing them in the crockery tray.

goals.description: Wash the water bottle and clean the tabletop
goals.rationale: The person washes a water bottle, wipes the tabletop with tissue paper, and disposes of trash.

goals.description: Open a tin, dispose of the lid, and put away tools
goals.rationale: The person uses a tin cutter to open a tin, throws away the lid, places a spoon in the dishwasher, and puts the cutter in a drawer.

goals.description: Wash and dry the peeler and weighing balance
goals.rationale: The person washes a peeler and a weighing balance in the sink, then dries the balance with a tablecloth.

goals.description: Tidy up the tabletop and arrange items
goals.rationale: The person organizes the workspace by moving bowls, folding a tablecloth, and rearranging bottles and jars.

goals.description: Retrieve utensils and ingredients and arrange them on the tabletop
goals.rationale: The person fetches a lid, spoon, herbs, and bottles from cabinets and drawers, placing them on the tabletop for cooking.
